# Known bugs that GoogleSQL's compliance tests (`just compliance`) or BigQuery's answers to
# unverified cases found. Each case gives BigQuery's answer after `!>`, which the emulator does
# not give yet: the case passes while the emulator answers otherwise. Every one of them is to be fixed; a fix fails its case, which then
# moves to the file of its function, written with `=>`.
#
# Inputs come from UNNEST so that the analyzer cannot fold the expression into a constant, which
# it evaluates correctly.

# BigQuery reports where the exception was thrown; QuickJS keeps only where an Error was created.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "throw new Error('boom');";
SELECT f()
!> error: Error: boom at f() line 1, column 1

# GEOGRAPHY holds no MULTILINESTRING, which ST_GEOGFROMTEXT makes of a line that overlaps itself.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 10 0, 5 0, 5 4)')
!> "MULTILINESTRING((1 0, 5 0, 10 0), (5 0, 5 4))"

# BigQuery snaps a polygon's edges as well as its vertices, which may leave a collection, and snaps
# rings that cross or touch at an edge to where they meet, which may be a new vertex; the
# emulator rejects these.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1.000000000006 0, 1.000000000012 0, 0 1, 0 0))')
!> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(LINESTRING(1 0, 1.000000000012 0), POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0), (0.000000000001 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0.000000000001 0))')
!> "POLYGON((1e-12 0, 1 0, 0 1, 1e-12 0), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 1e-12 0, 0.1 0.5))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.000000000001 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0.000000000001 0)')])
!> "POLYGON((1e-12 0, 1 0, 0 1, 1e-12 0), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 1e-12 0, 0.1 0.5))"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0.000000000001 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0.000000000001 0), (0 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0 0))')
!> "POLYGON((9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12, 1 0, 0 1, 9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12, 0.1 0.5))"

# ST_ASGEOJSON of a linestring is unsupported: S2EdgeTessellator adds the vertices BigQuery does,
# but one of them differs in its 15th digit.
SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)'))
!> "{ \"type\": \"LineString\", \"coordinates\": [ [1, 2], [1.49935211656563, 2.50032298430222], [1.99908512591253, 3.00045614878547], [2.49927553736666, 3.50036126939258], [3, 4] ] } "

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 10)'))
!> "{ \"type\": \"LineString\", \"coordinates\": [ [0, 0], [0, 10] ] } "

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 10)'))
!> "{ \"type\": \"LineString\", \"coordinates\": [ [0, 0], [0.618639928806863, 0.628146073885827], [1.23742858714765, 1.2562189063678], [1.8565147781743, 1.88414519414781], [2.47604745216536, 2.51185151008477], [2.78602782550677, 2.82559918349829], [3.09617577981484, 3.13926424113694], [3.40651000783595, 3.45283744211563], [3.71704922518836, 3.76630952614152], [4.02781217261568, 4.07967121155696], [4.33881761823049, 4.39291319337779], [4.65008435974713, 4.70602614132672], [4.96163122670251, 5.01900069786115], [5.27347708266412, 5.33182747619531], [5.58564082742387, 5.6444970583161], [5.89814139917688, 5.95699999299241], [6.21099777668389, 6.26932679377739], [6.52422898141621, 6.5814679370035], [6.83785407968182, 6.89341385976973], [7.15189218473157, 7.20515495792085], [7.46636245884384, 7.51668158401822], [7.78128411538655, 7.82798404530181], [8.09667642085494, 8.13905260164321], [8.41255869688361, 8.44987746348919], [8.72895032223134, 8.76044878979552], [9.04587073473709, 9.07075668595086], [9.36333943324537, 9.38079120169024], [9.68137597949937, 9.69054232899802], [10, 10] ] } "
